blocking_constraints.description: Shared regression lane uses source hashes bound by scripts/check_shb_retained.py; editing shared-lane sources mid-run causes 'source changed during retained verification' at save_record. Make source edits before launching the lane, not during.

DiscountIssuanceScope SCOPE_FIELDS include claim_period_days which is NOT a field on the published DiscountCode; use it only to derive expires_at = created_at + claim_period_days when building the prospective row.

The AFTER INSERT deferred trigger on shb_discountcode must only fire when a matching DiscountIssue exists (via EXISTS JOIN on id). Existing issue_fixture rows have no DiscountIssue — the trigger must pass them through.

The ordinary sandbox cannot start PostgreSQL via check_shb_retained.py; use dangerouslyDisableSandbox for retained-tool runs. 'Operation not permitted' errors on bwrap bind-mounts indicate the escalation is required.
